findings.summary: increment_counter performs an unsynchronized read-modify-write with no locking, so concurrent invocations lose updates (50 parallel increments yielded 3).
Zero-padded input is evaluated as octal by (( )), so 0144 wrongly passes the <=100 bound while 08 raises an arithmetic error and rejects a valid size.
With both arguments absent, caller and owner are both empty and compare equal, granting the read; an explicit non-empty owner check would fail closed.
The _or_fail name implies failure handling that is absent; it never verifies $storage is executable, so a missing backend surfaces only as exit 127.
